t: Seder tepillat lel sheni shel pesach usepirat haomer
s: Seder tepillat lel sheni shel pesach usepirat haomer ubo l' seipim: mitzvat aseh min hattora sheyyispor kol echad miyyisrael shiba shabuot yamim miyyom habaat qorban haomer, shenneemar "usepartem lakem mimmochorat hashshabbat miyyom habiakem et omer hattenupa sheba shabbatot temimot tihyena", veomer "shiba shabuot tispar lak vego'", vedareshu chakamim: "tispar lak", yakol bebet din, kemo beyobel shessoperin bebet din sheba shabbatot shanim umeqaddeshin shenat hachamishshim layyobel? Talmud lomar: "usepartem lakem", kede lesoprah lekol echad veechad. Veen hatztzibbur o sheliach tzibbur yekolim lispor bead kullam. Ap im echad metzavveh lachabero sheyyispor bishbilo vaasao shaliach lekak — eno yotze yede chobato keshello shama hassepira mippi chabero. Abal im hu beatzmo shama hassepira mippi chabero, im nitkavven latzet yede chobato bishmia zo, vegam chabero hammashmia nitkavven lehotzio — yatza yede chobato min hattora, shehashshomea hu keomer. Vehu sheshshama mippi hammechuyyab bemitzva zo. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shetztzarik shettehe sepira lekol echad veechad mammash, shekkol echad yispor beatzmo. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, shello lismok al shemiat hassepira mehashsheliach tzibbur. Abal habberaka yakol lishmoa mehashsheliach tzibbur lekattechilla ap im hu yodea lebarek beatzmo, sheasara sheosin mitzva bebat achat — yakol echad mehen lebarek bishbil kullam, kemo shennitbaer besiman ch'. Veachar sheshshama habberaka yispor miyyad:

Nashim vaabadim peturim mimmitzva zo, mippene shehu mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama. Ubemiqtzat medinot samu hannashim mitzva zo alehem choba. Veen chashash issur bemah shehen mebarekot aleha ap shehem peturot mimmenna, ayyen siman y"[z]. Umitzva zo noheget baaretz ubechutza laaretz, bipne habbayit veshello bipne habbayit. Veyesh omerim shebbazzeman hazzeh sheen bet hammiqdash qayyam veen maqribin haomer — en mitzva zo noheget kelal middibre tora, ella middibre soperim shettiqqenu "zeker lammiqdash". Veken iqqar. Umikkol maqom, kol mah shettiqqenu chakamim tiqqenu keen shel tora, veen chilluq benehem ella baddebarim sheyyitbaer:

Zeman haqrabat haomer hu bet"z benisan, shenneemar "mimmochorat hashshabbat yenipennu vego'". Veqibbelu chakamim shezzeh hu mimmochorat yom tob harishon shel pesach, umiyyom zeh atzmo matchilin lispor velo miyyom shelleacharayv, shenneemar "mehachel chermesh baqqama tachel lispor vego'", ha lamadta shezzeman hassepira hu bizman reshit haqqetzira, dehaynu bizman qetzirat haomer, uqetzirato hu qodem habaato velo achar kak. Vei epshar lehatchil hassepira beyom habaato mammash (veen haomer qareb ella bayyom mammash), shenneemar "temimot tihyena", veen atta motze "temimot" ella keshemmatchil lispor baereb, dehaynu shemmatchil hu lispor yom harishon belel t"z qodem or habboqer. Vehu haddin sepirat shear hayyamim sheenah ella ballayla, shemmin hassetam sepirat kol hayyamim hem shavin. Vekol hallayla kasher lispirat haomer, sheim shakach velo sapar bitchillat hallayla venizkar qodem sheala ammud hashshachar — chayyab lispor. Abal lekattechilla mitzva min hammubchar lispor bitchillat hallayla miyyad achar tepillat arbit. Veqodem sheyyispor ballayla tzarik lebarek, kederek shemmebarekin al kol hammitzvot, ben shel tora ben shel dibre soperim. Abal im shakach lispor ballayla venizkar bayyom — yispor belo beraka, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheim lo niqtzar haomer ballayla qotzerin oto bayyom, ulepikak im shakach o hezid velo sapar ballayla — chayyab lispor bayyom ulebarek, veyesh choleqin al zeh, lepikak yispor belo beraka, shessepeq berakot lehaqel:

Hassepira tzarik lebarek meummad, shenneemar "baqqama", vedareshu chakamim: al tiqra "baqqama" ella "beqoma" tachel lispor. Umikkol maqom, im mana meyushshab — yatza, lepi shedderasha zo enah ella asmakta bealma:

Min hattora tzarik limnot hayyamim vegam hashshabuot, shenneemar "tisperu chamishshim yom", kelomar ad chamishshim, veomer "shiba shabuot tispar lak", ketzad yispor shenehem? Keshemmaggia leshiba yamim yomar: "hayyom shiba yamim shehem shabua echad", ukeshemmaggia leyom arbaa asar yomar: "hayyom arbaa asar yom shehem shene shabuot", veken bishar kol sop shabua veshabua. Veim lo asa ken — lo yatza yede chobato min hattora:

Abal bayyamim shebben kol shabua veshabua, dehaynu miyyom ch' ad yom y"g vead biklal, umiyyom t"v ad yom esrim, veken hayyamim shebben shear hashshabuot — yesh omerim sheen tzarik limnot bahen hashshabuot ella hayyamim bilbad, kegon beyom ch' yomar: "hayyom shemona yamim", veen tzarik lomar "shehem shabua echad veyom echad". Veyesh omerim lehippuk, beyom ch' yomar: "hayyom shabua echad veyom echad", ubeyom t"v yomar: "hayyom b' shabuot veyom echad". Veyesh omerim shetztzarik lomar bahem sekum hayyamim vehashshabuot, kegon beyom ch' yomar: "shemona yamim shehem shabua echad veyom echad", veken bishar kol hayyamim tzarik lomar sekum kol hayyamim vehashshabuot uminyan hayyamim haodepim al hashshabua. Veken nitpashshet hamminhag bekol teputzot yisrael, veen leshannot. Umikkol maqom, im taa umana beachat mib' hassepirot (harishonot) bayyamim shebbeemtza hashshabuot — en tzarik lachazor velispor bazzeman hazzeh shehassepira middibre soperim. Veap bayyamim shehem sope hashshabuot, kegon yom z' vey"d vekayyotze bahem, im taa velo mana ella hayyamim bilbad velo hizkir hashshabuot kelal — yesh omerim sheen tzarik lachazor velispor bazzeman hazzeh, shehassepira enah ella "zeker", vekevan shessapar hayyamim — yatza. Abal im sapar shabuot bilbad, kegon sheamar: "hayyom shabua echad" o "shene shabuot", velo hizkir minyan hayyamim — tzarik lachazor velispor, lepi sheiqqar hassepira hu minyan hayyamim, shebbeminyan hayyamim bilbad yekolin lispor kol ham"t yom, abal beminyan hashshabuot bilbad belo hazkarat shum minyan yamim i epshar lispor ella hayyamim shehem sope hashshabuot. Veyesh omerim sheap im mana hayyamim lebad tzarik lachazor velispor, shekkol mah shettiqqenu chakamim tiqqenu keen shel tora. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lachazor velispor belo beraka:

Im sapar beotiyyot a"b sheamar: "hayyom yom ale"p", o "yom b'", o "g' yamim" — yesh omerim sheyyatza yede chobato. Veyesh omerim shello yatza. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lachazor velispor belo beraka. Im lo amar "hayyom", ella mana setam: kak vekak yamim laomer — lo yatza yede chobato, vetzarik lachazor velispor bibraka, dekevan sheamar: kak vekak yamim, hare lo sapar et etzem hayyom hazzeh shehu omed bo, vehattora omra: "tisperu chamishshim yom", shettispor hayyom atzmo, sheyyomar: hayyom kak vekak. Abal im amar: hayyom kak vekak velo amar "laomer" — yatza, shemmeiqqar haddin en tzarik lomar kelal "laomer", ella shennahagu kak lebaer yapeh bassepira leezeh dabar soperim, veen zeh meakkeb kelal bediabad. Veyesh nohagin lomar "baomer". Veen leshabbesh shum nussach ki shenehem nekonim. (Veyesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lomar "laomer" achar minyan hayyamim qodem minyan hashshabuot, kegon "hayyom shemona yamim laomer shehem shabua echad veyom echad"):

Derek tzachut leshon haqqodesh lomar "yamim" leshon rabbim mishshenayim vead asara vead biklal, abal meachad asar vaelak yomar "yom" leshon yachid. Vetob lomar minyan hammuat qodem minyan hamrubbeh, kegon "echad veesrim" velo "esrim veechad". Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimdinot ellu shedderek lispor minyan hammuat qodem, abal bimqomot shedderek lispor minyan hamrubbeh qodem — yakol lomar gam bassepira keminhag meqomo:

"Shabua" hu leshon zakar, velaken yomar "shabua echad" velo "achat", ubashshabua hashsheni yomar "shene" velo "shette", ubashshabua hashshelishi yomar "shelosha" velo "shalosh", veken bishar hashshabuot:
Muttar lispor bekol lashon shemmebin, abal im eno mebin hallashon shessoper bo, apillu sapar bilshon haqqodesh, im eno mebino — lo yatza, dekevan sheeno yodea hamminyan — en zo sepira kelal:

Achar hassepira nohagin lomar: "yehi ratzon sheyyibbaneh bet hammiqdash ku'", lepi sheakshav en anu soperin ella "zeker lammiqdash", veen bispira zo asiyyat mitzva kelal, shehammitzva hu lispor laomer, veakshav en lanu omer lispor lo, ella shechakamim tiqqenu lispor "zeker lammiqdash", lepikak mitpallelin: "sheyyibbaneh bet hammiqdash" uneqayyem hammitzva ketiqqunah. (Veyesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lomar achar kak mizmor "elohim yechannenu vibarekenu" ve"anna bekoach" ve"ribbono shel olam"):

Yesh omerim shemmuttar lebarek velispor beben hashshemashot. Ap al pi shehu sepeq layla usepeq yom heabar, veim ken heak yomar: "hayyom shene yamim", shemma adayin hu yom rishon? Mikkol maqom kevan shehassepira bazzeman hazzeh middibre soperim — sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shellekattechilla en lehaknis atzmo lide sapeq apillu middibre soperim, veen lispor ad tzet hakkokabim shehu layla vadday. Veken osin hamdaqdeqim. Veken rauy lekol adam laasot. Umikkol maqom, hamminhag hehamon akshav kassebara harishona lispor beben hashshemashot. Umi sherotzeh ledaqdeq lispor betzet hakkokabim vehu mitpallel arbit mibbeod yom im tzibbur hammitpallelin arbit im samuk lachasheka vesoperim beben hashshemashot — tob sheyyispor immahem belo beraka, veyachshob bedato: im eshkach lispor ballayla hareni somek al sepira zo latzet bah yede chobati, veim lo eshkach ballayla hare dati akshav shello latzet bispira zo, sheap lehaomerim shemmitzvot en tzerikot kavvana latzet bahen yede chobato, mikkol maqom keshemmekavven beperush shello latzet bahen yede chobato — bevadday eno yotze beal korcho, ulepikak kesheyyizkor ballayla yispor bibraka. Abal im lo hitna bedato beperush shello latzet bispira zo kesheyyizkor ballayla, ella sapar setam, ap shello berak akshav vegam lo ana "amen" achar birkat hatztzibbur — lo yebarek kesheyyispor ballayla, shemma haya kebar layla keshessapar beben hashshemashot, ukebar yatza yede chobato lehaomerim shemmitzvot en tzerikot kavvana. Veap lehaomerim shemmitzvot tzerikot kavvana, mikkol maqom hassepira bazzeman hazzeh middibre soperim veyesh omerim shemmitzvot middibre soperim ledibre hakkol en tzerikot kavvana, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h. Vaapillu lo sapar immahem kelal, ella sheshshama hassepira min echad (u)min hatztzibbur shessaperu velo nitkavven kelal lehotzio, vegam hu lo nitkavven latzet bishmia zo, ella shama lepi tummo — lo yebarek kesheyyispor ballayla, shehashshomea keoneh. Vaapillu im haya mechashsheb: en ani mitkavven latzet bispira zo — en zeh kelum, lehaomerim shemmitzvot en tzerikot kavvana kelal, ella im ken mechashsheb: ani mitkavven shello latzet bah. Vekol zeh hu beben hashshemashot, abal qodem ben hashshemashot — en minhag kelal lispor. Apillu beereb shabbat shemmaqdimin ligmor tepillat arbit betzibbur bebet hakkeneset qodem ben hashshemashot — en hatztzibbur soperin kelal bebet hakkeneset, ella kol echad soper bebeto kesheyyaggia hazzeman. Veim tau bayyom hamunnan ubereku vesaperu veachar kak nitpazzeru heabim venoda shehaya qodem ben hashshemashot — tzerikin lachazor velispor, abal lo yebarek shenit im keshessaperu haya mippelag hammincha vaelak, shehare minhag haolam liqrot qeriat shema shel arbit mippelag hammincha vaelak lepi shessomekin al haomerim shemmippelag hammincha vaelak keshem shehu kelayla leinyan tepillat arbit lerabbi yehuda kak hu kelayla leinyan qeriat shema shel arbit, veim ken hu haddin shehu kelayla leinyan sepirat haomer lerabbi yehuda lepi dibrehem. Umikkol maqom, tzerikim lachazor velispor kesheyyaggia hazzeman, lepi shehaiqqar kehaomerim shemmippelag hammincha eno chashub kelayla apillu lerabbi yehuda ella leinyan tepilla bilbad, abal lo leinyan shear debarim shemmitzvatam ballayla, kemo shennitbaer besiman rl"h:

Abal hamdaqdeqim lispor betzet hakkokabim shettau bayyom hamunnan vesaperu beben hashshemashot — en tzarik lachazor velispor kelal betzet hakkokabim meiqqar haddin apillu belo beraka, lepi shekkebar yatza yede chobato legamre meiqqar haddin bemah shessaperu beben hashshemashot shehu sepeq layla, usepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. (Umikkol maqom kede lachosh ledibre haomerim shessepira bazzeman hazzeh min hattora — tob lahem sheyyachzeru lispor betzet hakkokabim belo beraka):

Mi sheshshoel oto chabero beben hashshemashot kamma yeme hassepira belayla zeh — yomar lo: etmol haya kak vekak, sheim yomar lo: hayyom kak vekak — lo yukal hu atzmo lachazor velimnot bibraka, lepi shekkebar yatza yede chobato bemah sheamar lachabero: hayyom kak vekak, lepi dibre haomerim sheen tzarik kavvana latzet. Ap shello amar "laomer" — en bekak kelum. Abal hashshoel yakol lispor bibraka ap sheshshama kebar hassippur mehammeshib, mikkol maqom beshaa sheshshama haya bedato lachazor velispor, shehare bishbil kak hu shomea, venimtza shehaya bedato beperush shello latzet bishmia zo. Abal hammeshib lo haya bedato beperush bishat hatteshuba sherotzeh lachazor velispor shenit achar kak ap shebbeemet ken hu, mikkol maqom kevan shello haya bedato beperush — yatza yede chobato lehaomerim sheen tzerikot kavvana. Abal im lo amar lo: hayyom kak vekak, ella heshib lo setam: kak vekak laomer — lo yatza bazeh ledibre hakkol, veyachzor veyispor bibraka. Umikkol maqom, yoter tob lomar: etmol haya kak vekak:

Vekol zeh kesheshshoalo beben hashshemashot, abal qodem laken ap im amar lo: hayyom kak vekak laomer — chozer vesoper bibraka, kevan shehaiqqar kehaomerim sheap mippelag hammincha vaelak eno chashub kelayla ella leinyan tepilla bilbad, vegam lehaomerim shehu kelayla — hare yesh omerim sheap mitzvot middibre soperim tzerikot kavvana latzet bahen. (Umikkol maqom lekattechilla tob lizzaher mippelag hammincha vaelak shello yomar: hayyom kak vekak):

Muttar lispor qodem tepillat arbit apillu bemotzae shabbat shemmosipin mechol al haqqodesh, shemmikkol maqom layla hu veeno nechshab leyom heabar ella leyom hammochorat. Umikkol maqom, rauy lehaqdim tepillat arbit lassepira, shettepillat arbit hi tedira vehassepira enah tedira, vetadir qodem lesheeno tadir:

Veim darko lehitpallel arbit mibbeod yom veliqrot al mittato kol hag' parashiyyot, ap shemmuttar lo leekol qodem qeriat shema sheal hammitta kemo shennitbaer besiman rl"h, mikkol maqom bime hassepira lo yatchil leekol apillu seuda qetanna chatzi shaa qodem zeman sepira, dehaynu chatzi shaa qodem ben hashshemashot, gezera shemma yimshok bisudato veyimmana missepirat haomer. Ella im ken hu maqom shennohagin shehashshammash qore lispor sepira keshemmaggia zemannah, sheaz en lachosh shemma yimshok bisudato, kemo shennitbaer besiman rl"b. (Vaapillu bimqomot shello nahagu ken, im abar vehitchil bisuda betok chatzi shaa samuk lizman hassepira — en tzarik lehapsiq beemtza seudato). Abal im hitchil hasseuda leachar shehiggia zeman hassepira — tzarik lehapsiq velispor beemtza seudato lehaomerim shessepira bazzeman hazzeh hi min hattora, kemo shennitbaer besiman rl"h. Veap shehaiqqar kehaomerim shessepira bazzeman hazzeh hi middibre soperim, mikkol maqom bedabar sheen bo torach kelal, dehaynu lehapsiq meat velispor — yesh lachosh lassebara harishona:

Im eno yodea ezeh yom hu bassepira upatach uberak al daat sheyyispor kemo sheyyishma mechabero, veachar habberaka shataq veshama mechabero vesapar kamohu — yatza yede chobat habberaka, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek shenit qodem sepirato ap al pi shebbishat beraka rishona lo haya yodea al ezeh yom hu mebarek:
Abal lekattechilla en laasot ken, velo yebarek ad sheyyodea ezeh yom hu mehassepira, kede sheyyeda al mah hu mebarek:

Im berak al daat lispor "arbaa yamim laomer", shehu sabur shehayyom yom rebii, uleachar sheggamar habberaka nizkar shehayyom yom chamishi — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, ella soper miyyad "chamishsha" al semak habberaka shebberak kebar. Ap al pi shehabberaka hayeta al daat yom rebii — en bekak kelum, lepi sheddebarim shebballeb enan debarim leinyan zeh, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"t:

Im haya omed beyom rebii uberak al daat lispor "arbaa" vetaa bedibburo vesapar "chamishsha" — tzarik lachazor velispor "arbaa", kevan sheyyatza sheqer mippiv, shehayyom yom rebii hu vehu sapar "chamishsha" bepiv. Ap shehaya bemachashabto "arbaa" — en zeh kelum, shemmitzvat hassepira hi bappeh. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik lachazor ulebarek qodem shechozer lispor "arbaa" (apillu im taa bitchilla bedato, shehaya sabur shehu yom chamishi uberak al daat lispor "chamishsha", uleachar shessapar nizkar shehayyom yom rebii — ap al pi ken en tzarik lachazor ulebarek), lepi sheyyotze babberaka shebberak kebar im lo hipsiq benetayim bidbarim acherim. Abal hassepira harishona enah chashuba hepseq, kevan shennitasseq bedabar shebberak alayv ella shello ala beyado kahogen:

(Ukeshechozer lispor "arbaa" — tzarik lomar: "hayyom arbaa ku'". Veim chozer lispor betok kede dibbur lassepira harishona — en tzarik lachazor velomar "hayyom", ella yomar miyyad: "arbaa yamim laomer"):

Veyesh omerim sheim shakach lispor belayla achat — en tzarik lispor kelal bishar kol hallelot, lepi shekkebar hipsid mimmitzvat sepirat haomer legamre keshechisser mimmennu yom echad, shenneemar "temimot tihyena". Veyesh choleqin veomerim shetztzarik lispor bishar kol hallelot, lepi shekkol layla hi mitzva bipne atzmah veenan teluyot zo bazo:

Uleinyan halaka, nohagin lispor bishar lelot belo beraka, ben sheshshakach ballayla harishon ben sheshshakach beechad mishshear kol hallelot, lepi shessepeq berakot lehaqel. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello nizkar kol hallayla vekol yom hammochorat, abal im nizkar lemachar bayyom vesapar belo beraka kemo shennitbaer lemala — yispor bishar kol hallelot bibraka, shehare ap lepi hassebara harishona lo hipsid mitzvat hassepira bechesron layla echad, kevan shessapar lemachar bayyom, vahare hen niqraot "temimot", shessoper kol ham"t yom. Veap sheyyesh omerim shehassepira enah ella ballayla, sheap im shakach lispor ballayla en tzarik lispor bayyom, veim ken ap im sapar bayyom en sepira zo shava kelum lehashlim mispar ham"t yom, mikkol maqom hare yesh omerim sheap im lo sapar kelal yom echad o apillu yamim harbeh soper bishar hallelot bibraka:

Vekol zeh keshebbari lo shello sapar belayla echad, abal im hu mesuppaq baddabar, ap shello sapar lemachar bayyom — yispor bishar lelot bibraka, dekevan sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma sapar ballayla, veyesh lehistappeq gam ken shemma kehaomerim shekkol layla velayla hi mitzva bipne atzmah veenan teluyot zeh bazeh, nimtza sheyyesh kan sepeq sepeqa lehachamir lehatzrik beraka usepira bishar hallelot. Veken bekol maqom shennitbaer shetztzarik lachazor velispor belo beraka mechamat hassapeq sheyyesh bassepira harishona, im lo chazar vesapar — yispor bishar hallelot bibraka:

Bimqomot shennohagin leqaddesh ulehabdil bebet hakkeneset al hayyayin — soperim haomer belel shabbat veyom tob achar haqqiddush, lepi shekkol mah shennukal lehaqdim qedushshat hayyom yesh lanu lehaqdim. Ubemotzae shabbat veyom tob soperim qodem hahabdala, lepi shekkol mah shennukal leachar hahabdala yesh lanu leacharah, kede shello tehe qedushshat hayyom niret alenu kemassaoy. Uben bimqomot shemmabdilin bemotzae shabbat qodem "veyitten leka" miyyad achar qaddish "titqabbel" [uben bimqomot sheomerim "veyitten leka" qodem hahabdala — soperim miyyad achar qaddish "titqabbel"], lepi sheyyesh lanu lehaqdim hassepira bekol mah sheepshar, umiyyad shennistalleqa hattepilla beqaddish shelleachareha — chal alenu mitzvat sepira:

Ukeshechal yom tob haacharon bemotzae shabbat sheomerim qiddush vehabdala al kos echad — i epshar lispor achar haqqiddush veqodem hahabdala kemo bishar lel yom tob umotzae shabbatot, shehare asur lehapsiq benehem kelal, azay soperim qodem haqqiddush vehahabdala velo achar kak, lepi shekkol mah shennukal leacher hahabdala yesh lanu leacharah. (Abal yom sheni shel pesach shechal bemotzae shabbat — en meqaddeshin veen mabdilin kelal bebet hakkeneset, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tp"z):

Bekol yom tob keshechal yom rishon beshabbat nohagin lomar belel sheni hammaarabit hashshayyakim lelel rishon, shebbelel shabbat en omerim maarabit mittaam shennitbaer besiman ar"h, chutz miyyom rishon shel pesach shechal lihyot beshabbat, shennohagin lomar belel sheni hammaarabit hashshayyakim lelel sheni, mishshum bikkur lassepira shehuzkar bo seder qetzirat haomer shehaya niqtzar belayla zeh:

Asur leekol chadash ap bazzeman hazzeh, ben lechem ben qali ben karmel, ad techillat lel y"z benisan, shenneemar "velechem veqali vekarmel lo toklu ad etzem hayyom hazzeh vego'", ad vead biklal. Ella shebbizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam, mishsheqqarab haomer beyom t"z — huttar hechadash miyyad, shenneemar "ad habiakem et qorban elohekem", abal akshav sheen lanu qorban — hare etzem hayyom mattir, dehaynu leachar sheabar kol etzem hayyom. Ubaggola keshello hayu yodeim yom shenniqba bo hachodesh beeretz yisrael — hayu asurin leekol chadash gam kol yom y"z ad techillat lel y"ch, lepi shehu sapeq shel tora, shehechadash asur gam bechutz laaretz min hattora, shenneemar "bekol moshebotekem". Vegam akshav sheanu yodeim yom qebiut hachodesh — en leshannot minhag abotenu, mittaam sheyyitbaer:

Veakshav en haolam nizharin kelal beissur chadash. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut bimqomot sherob hattebua nizraat qodem happesach, o bimqomot shemmebiin lahem tebua mimmeqomot sherob hattebua nizraat qodem happesach, sheen bah issur chadash, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rtz"g ayyen sham. Vehammachmirim al atzmam bammeqomot hahem venizhar missetam tebua sheenah yedua lo shehi yeshnah — en tzarik lizzaher mippelitat hakkelim shennitbashshel bahem mimmin sherotzeh lebashshel akshav yashan, lepi shemmin bemino en tzarik shishshim ella middibre soperim, veen lehachmir kol kak bistam tebua sheen bah ella chumra bealma. Vegam bimqomot sherob hattebua nizraat achar happesach, kegon bimdinot polin sherob hashshibbolet shual vehasseorim sheosin mehem hashshekar nizrain achar happesach, vegam en mebiin lesham tebua kelal mimmedinot acherot shezzorein bahem qodem happesach — ap al pi ken en rob haolam nohagin sham issur chadash. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut lepi sheshsham hu sheat haddechaq, sheiqqar shetiyyatam hu hashshekar, lepikak hem somekim al miqtzat harishonim hassoberim shechadash bechutz laaretz enah ella middibre soperim sheggazeru mishshum eretz yisrael, velo gazeru ella bammeqomot hassemukim leeretz yisrael, kegon mitzrayim veammon umoab ubabel, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shl"a. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut acher shessoberim shechadash eno noheg ella bitbua shehu shel yisrael bishat qetzira, abal lo beshel nokrim. Ulepi zeh tzarik lehazhir leyisreelim haddarim bakkeparim sheyyesh lahem tebua zerua achar happesach besadeh shel hassar sheyyinhagu bah issur chadash. Abal kol baal nepesh lo yismok al hammattirim hallalu veyachamir leatzmo bekol mah sheepshar lo kehaskamat rob harishonim vehaacharonim shehechadash noheg min hattora ap bechutz laaretz ubekol maqom ap beshel nokrim, ki ken iqqar. Ayyen beyoreh dea siman rtz"g shehannizhar mechadash yesh lo lizzaher gam miyyen-sarap umimme debash sheheemiduhu beshimre shekar, ayyen sham kol perate din hechadash:
